stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS raises cancer waits and cross-border treatment
stories.summary: A Fflint Wrecsam MS has asked the First Minister what arrangements are in place for north Wales cancer patients to be treated elsewhere in the UK when services in Wales cannot meet their needs. Nigel Williams MS (Reform UK, Fflint Wrecsam) raised it during First Minister’s Questions on Tuesday, 3 November, in exchanges on cooperation

stories.title: Remembrance Sunday road closures in Mold, Flint, Holywell, Buckley and Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: Roads will close in nine Flintshire towns and villages on Sunday 8 November as communities hold Remembrance Sunday services. The first closures start at 9am in Mold and in Hope and Caergwrle, and the last, in Flint, run until 4.30pm. Service details have been published for Mold, Flint, Hawarden and Buckley so far. stories.title: Up to 126,000 young adults could get easier access to their Child Trust Fund money
stories.summary: Families of young adults who lack the mental capacity to manage money will be able to get their Child Trust Fund savings straight from providers rather than going through the courts, under government plans. stories.title: Bulrushes cleared from Buckley ponds to help great crested newts breed
stories.summary: Bulrushes have been cleared from ponds at a Buckley nature reserve to give great crested newts better places to lay their eggs. stories.title: Ewloe Green homes to lose power from 11pm for underground cable fault repair
stories.summary: Homes in Ewloe Green will have their power switched off at 11pm tonight so SP Energy Networks can carry out emergency repairs to an underground cable fault.
